description: This file implements the PresenceManager in a Go project, responsible for managing presence leases, heartbeats, and node activity status within an internal service. It handles starting/stopping presence tracking, recovering state from a database, and periodically checking for expired leases to mark nodes as inactive.

classes.name: PresenceManager
classes.description: Manages presence leases for nodes, handling heartbeat updates, expirations, and recovery from persistent storage.

methods.name: NewPresenceManager
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new PresenceManager with default or provided configuration.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the background goroutine that periodically checks for expired presence leases.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the presence manager, terminating its background process.

methods.name: Touch
methods.description: Updates the last seen timestamp for a given node, marking it as active.

methods.name: Forget
methods.description: Removes a node's presence lease, effectively forgetting its presence.

methods.name: HasLease
methods.description: Checks if a node has an active presence lease.

methods.name: SetExpireCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function to be called when a node's presence lease expires.

methods.name: RecoverFromDatabase
methods.description: Loads previously known nodes and initializes leases based on stored heartbeats, to recover state after restart.

methods.name: loop
methods.description: Internal goroutine loop that periodically checks for expired presence leases.

methods.name: checkExpirations
methods.description: Checks all leases for expiration and marks nodes inactive if lease durations exceed thresholds.

methods.name: markInactive
methods.description: Marks a node as inactive in the status manager and triggers expiration callback.
